授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: このコースは教育の政治的本質に焦点を当たって、教育の政治性に関する理論において三つの基本的な概念（再生産、抵抗、批判）を紹介し、議論する。理解を深めるために、それらの概念を使って参加者自身の教育経験を振り返って、そして関心のあるアジアにおける教育課題を検証する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course explores the relationship between education and politics from the perspective that education is inherently political. In other words, there is no education that is apolitical or politically neutral.
It introduces, demonstrates, and discusses three basic concepts in the theory of politics of education: reproduction, resistance, and critique. It guides students to use these concepts to examine their own educational experience and educational issues of concern in Asian contexts.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: 50%. Students are to submit a course report (in Japanese or English) in Week 7 that examines an educational issue of concern in Asian contexts from the political perspective by using discussed concepts.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: 20%. Students are to give a presentation in Week 7 that examines and reflects on their own educational experience from the political perspective by using discussed concepts.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: 30%. Active engagement in class discussion is expected.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Attendance is the prerequisite for class discussion.
